pilot.status: DEVELOPMENT_NEURAL_PILOT (round 6, commit 7e25f68); preserved; not re-scored; its model seeds are excluded below

pilot_streams.sampling_keys: seed_v2(seed, experiment, joint, condition=<arm>, level=<target|joint>, example=i, replicate=0, branch=<direct|sequential>) -> random.Random -> getrandbits(63) -> torch.Generator (low 32 bits used): no split field, so dev example i and test example i drew identical initial noise; no step-count field, so 128 and 32 shared noise
pilot_streams.dev_uses: dev-loss diagnostic at 90/100% (fixed noise key branch='dev_loss'); labels UNDERTRAINING_FLAG, SOLVER_SENSITIVE (dev 128 vs 32), non-finite; a descriptive dev Test P was computed and seen before the test stage; the checkpoint was the final iterate and no score-based selection was performed; the independence of that reading from the test outcome is not assumed, only recorded

rng.model_init: torch.manual_seed(model_init) before constructing the networks (integer per replicate and arm)
rng.train_stream: fa.train(seed=train_stream): torch.Generator for (x0, t) noise and random.Random for minibatch indices and the shared arm's pattern choice
rng.dev_loss_noise: fixed (x0, t) for the held-out dev loss at 18000 and 20000 updates
rng.sampling: stable hash seed_v2 over {experiment, joint, split, replicate, arm, pattern, example (conditioning id), branch, sample_id, purpose='sampling:<level>'}; one stdlib Gaussian stream per sample; the solver step count is deliberately absent so 128/256/512 share every sample's initial noise; direct and sequential never share a stream; a fresh y is drawn for every z sample of the sequential branch
rng.permutation: stable hash with purpose='permutation', split, replicate, arm, level, steps

data.dev: unchanged rows (200); sampling keys now carry split='dev'
data.standardisation: y, z divided by the train-split sds (unchanged)

solver.rule: the primary is fixed; 256/512 are numerical sensitivity endpoints with the same gap and quality estimators and paired differences; no permutation test is run at 256/512; nothing is selected by any outcome

evaluation.test_statistic: mean ED_V, upper tail (Test P), at 128 only

families.target_auxiliary: 8 target tests (4 replicates x 2 arms) at 128, Holm; smallest attainable p 0.005 vs first threshold 0.05/8 = 0.00625
families.joint_secondary: 8 joint tests at 128, Holm, separate; the round-6 joint p = 0.035 stays unadjusted and is not re-scored

evaluation.primary_effect: Theta_128 = mean_i mean_r d_ri(128), d_ri(h) = ED_U(shared)_ri - ED_U(independent)_ri; conditional on the four fit-pairs; per-replicate means shown side by side; example-level paired CIs; bootstrap resamples examples carrying all replicates/arms/steps; 4 x 200 never pooled as 800
evaluation.quality: per example: unbiased sample ED to the true conditional for the direct and the sequential branch (same population estimand as the closed-form control distance; different estimator and, for this round, different test examples), sd ratios and mean shifts for both branches

labels.inconclusive: MODEL_FIT_OR_NUMERICS_INCONCLUSIVE only for non-finite losses or samples
labels.numerics: NUMERICS_NOT_SEPARATED stays whenever the paired 256-128 or 512-128 difference of the gap estimate has a 95% CI excluding 0; agreement is not an ODE-limit proof
labels.outcome_labels: SINGLE_PROBE_MULTI_INITIALIZATION_EVIDENCE if all four replicate means of d(128) share the sign of Theta_128 and their pointwise CIs exclude 0 in the same direction; MIXED_REPLICATION otherwise; both conditional on this probe and these fits

budget.blocked: BLOCKED_BUDGET before any result if the smoke estimate exceeds the remaining cap; N, M and seeds are not reduced
budget.incomplete: INCOMPLETE_BUDGET with saved checkpoints and completed replicates; no seed substitution or arm selection

order: per replicate: train both arms -> dev (primary level, no test statistic) -> labels -> test (128 with Test P; 256; 512)
nothing changed after any p-value or effect is seen
